page-gutter.$description: Horizontal padding of the app frame and page containers (24px): enough to separate content from the window edge without spending width a wide table needs.

section-gap.$description: Gap between panels and page regions, e.g. job board and detail pane (16px).

panel-padding.$description: Inner padding of panels, cards, popovers, and dialogs (12px).

stack-gap.$description: Vertical gap between form fields and between stacked blocks inside a panel (12px).

component-gap.$description: Gap between related controls: buttons in a toolbar, filters in a filter bar, fields in one form row (8px).

field-gap.$description: Gap between a label and its input, or an icon and its text (4px).

cell-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding inside table cells and list rows (8px).

control-height.$description: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, and toolbar controls (32px); above the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px target minimum.

row-height.$description: Table and list row height (32px), equal to control-height so filter bars line up with the rows below.
